title: Palette Guard
summary: Simulates colour-blind vision for chart series and flags pairs that become hard to tell apart, with the smallest lightness fix.
description: Chart palette check that simulates protan, deutan and tritan vision (Machado 2009), flags every pair under a CIEDE2000 threshold, and offers the smallest lightness-only fix that clears all clashes, or patterns and direct labels when no colour change can.
catches: Series pairs that look alike for protan, deutan or tritan vision
Pairs already too close in normal vision
Smallest lightness-only fix that clears every clash
Cases needing patterns or direct labels instead
limits: Simulates full dichromacy (severity 1.0); milder forms are not modelled separately
A colour difference threshold isn't the same as legibility on your background
a11y: Series list is labelled; each colour input has an aria-label
Clash status is in a polite live region and marked in text (", clashes")
Fix button has an aria-label describing the change
stops: Chart colours look identical to colour-blind readers
